purpose: Test whether adaptive separator/tensor/rank-message elimination can evade the fixed multiplicative-quotient barrier while retaining polynomial-size exact boundary states.

construction.boundary_variables: x_1,...,x_k on the left and y_1,...,y_k on the right
construction.3cnf_encoding: For each i use (NOT x_i OR y_i OR y_i) AND (x_i OR NOT y_i OR NOT y_i). This is a 3-CNF with 2k clauses and size O(k).
construction.compatibility_matrix: M_k[a,b]=1 iff EQ_k(a,b)=1 for a,b in {0,1}^k.
construction.identity: M_k is exactly the 2^k by 2^k identity matrix after indexing rows and columns by the same lexicographic assignment order.

theorem.name: EXACT_BILINEAR_SEPARATOR_MESSAGE_FOR_EQUALITY_REQUIRES_DIMENSION_2_TO_K_V0_2
theorem.statement: Let K be any field. Suppose an exact separator scheme represents every left boundary assignment a by u_a in K^d and every right boundary assignment b by v_b in K^d, and decides compatibility by a fixed bilinear form u_a^T H v_b = M_k[a,b], where H is d by d. Then d >= 2^k. The same lower bound holds for any factorization M_k=UV with inner dimension d.
proof: The compatibility matrix M_k is I_{2^k}.
Therefore rank_K(M_k)=2^k over every field K.
If M_k=U H V^T with U,V having d columns, then rank(M_k) <= rank(H) <= d.
Because EQ_k has a 3-CNF encoding of size O(k), the exponential message dimension cannot be charged to an exponentially large input.
theorem.corollary: No universal exact dynamic-programming/tensor-contraction scheme whose only cross-separator information is a polynomial-dimensional linear or bilinear message can remain polynomial when separator width k is unbounded.
scope_firewall: This is a lower bound on the declared linear/bilinear message model, not on all algorithms.
It does not rule out nonlinear encodings, adaptive global transformations, determinant/Pfaffian-style cancellation, randomized algorithms, interactive/proof search, or P=NP.
It does not imply that every formula exposes a width-k equality separator; it exhibits an O(k)-size 3-CNF family for which such an exact interface has full rank.
It does not convert a proof-system lower bound into a problem lower bound.

discard_or_restrict: generic exact tensor-network contraction justified solely by polynomial bond/message dimension across arbitrary separators
rank-based separator compression that promises poly(k) representative dimension for arbitrary 3-SAT interfaces
fixed bilinear left/right compatibility sketches for unrestricted boundary width
still_live: global nonlinear cancellation where no explicit separator compatibility matrix is represented
determinant/Pfaffian-like mechanisms that derive a scalar invariant without a polynomial-dimensional exact boundary factorization
adaptive elimination with a provable global progress measure that prevents large hard interfaces from ever being materialized
new structural theorem forcing every hard E6 instance into a polynomially contractible nonlocal representation
